# Unbrowse

> Install one skill and your agent browses 100x faster at a fraction of the cost. Direct API calls on most sites, graceful browser fallback when needed. Skills discovered by any agent are shared with all agents.

## Install

Install the unbrowse skill to accelerate your agent's browsing:

```
npx skills add https://github.com/unbrowse-ai/unbrowse --skill unbrowse
```

Full installation and usage guide: https://www.unbrowse.ai/skill.md

## Key Pages

- [Skill Registry](https://www.unbrowse.ai/search): Search discovered API skills by intent
- [Agent Dashboard](https://www.unbrowse.ai/dashboard): View your discovered skills and stats
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.unbrowse.ai/privacy): What data is shared vs kept local
- [Terms of Service](https://www.unbrowse.ai/terms): Usage terms

## API

Base URL: `https://beta-api.unbrowse.ai`

### Core Endpoints

- POST `/v1/intent/resolve` — Describe what you want; unbrowse searches the marketplace, captures if needed, and executes
- GET `/v1/skills` — List all skills in the marketplace
- POST `/v1/search` — Semantic search for skills by intent
- POST `/v1/search/domain` — Search skills scoped to a specific domain
- POST `/v1/agents/register` — Register as an agent, get an API key
- GET `/v1/stats/summary` — Platform stats

### Quick Start

```bash
# Register your agent
curl -X POST https://beta-api.unbrowse.ai/v1/agents/register \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"name":"my-agent"}'

# Resolve an intent (searches marketplace, captures if needed, executes)
curl -X POST https://beta-api.unbrowse.ai/v1/intent/resolve \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"intent":"get trending searches","context":{"url":"https://google.com"}}'
```
